description.en: 2D arcade shooter game built with C and Raylib, implementing low-level data structures, game loop mechanics, and persistent game state management.
description.id: Game arcade shooter 2D yang dibangun dengan C dan Raylib, mengimplementasikan struktur data tingkat rendah, mekanika game loop, dan manajemen state permainan persisten.

impact.en: Led team development focusing on object behavior design, game loop optimization, and user experience management throughout the development cycle.
impact.id: Memimpin pengembangan tim dengan fokus pada desain perilaku objek, optimasi game loop, dan manajemen pengalaman pengguna sepanjang siklus pengembangan.

highlights.en: Manual implementation of data structures at low level.
highlights.id: Implementasi manual struktur data di tingkat rendah.

highlights.en: Optimized game loop for responsive gameplay and object behavior.
highlights.id: Game loop teroptimasi untuk gameplay responsif dan perilaku objek.

highlights.en: Persistent game state and local high-score tracking system.
highlights.id: State permainan persisten dan sistem tracking high-score lokal.

highlights.en: Team collaboration and leadership in game development workflow.
highlights.id: Kolaborasi tim dan kepemimpinan dalam alur pengembangan game.
